source.primary_witnesses: 11Q12 preserves SPARSE FRAGMENTS touching this chapter. Where 11Q12 preserves Hebrew, Hebrew is primary; otherwise Ge'ez (Charles 1902 + VanderKam 1989) is primary. Greek not preserved for this chapter (Epiphanius/Syncellus begin in chs 8-9 for geographical material).
source.verificationStatus: best-effort reconstruction; verification pending against García Martínez et al. 1998 DJD XXIII + VanderKam 1989 + VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.fetchedFrom: García Martínez et al. 1998 DJD XXIII; VanderKam 1989 CSCO 510-511; Charles 1902; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.citation: García Martínez et al. 1998 DJD XXIII; VanderKam 1989; VanderKam 2018 Hermeneia.
source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 7 — NOAH'S VINEYARD + CURSE OF CANAAN + DIVISION OF EARTH AMONG NOAH'S SONS + Noah's ETHICAL DEATHBED-TESTAMENT. **Bridge between the Flood narrative and the table-of-nations + sacred-geography material of chs 8-10.** **Cross-corpus density**: foundational text for the THREE-CONTINENT-PARTITION (Asia/Africa/Europe) of Sem/Ham/Japhet, picked up in chs 8-9. Noah's testament also picks up the Watchers + Mastema themes.

verses.text_geez: ወበ፫ ሰቡዕ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ተከለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወይነ፡ በደብር፡ ዘሎቱ፡ ስሙ፡ ሉብር፡ እምነ፡ አድባር፡ ዘአራራት፡ ኀበ፡ ቆመት፡ ታቦት፡ ወአፍረየ፡ ፍሬ፡ በራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-3 sabuʿ la-zəntu ʾiyobēləwu takala Noḫ wayna ba-dabr zalottu səmu Lubar ʾəm-nə ʾadbār zaʾArārāt ḫaba qomat tābot wa-ʾafraya fəre ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat
verses.notes: **Noah plants a vineyard on Mount Lubar (Ararat).** **Mount Lubar = the post-Flood mountain of mooring.** Calendrical: jubilee 28, week 3, year 4 = first vintage. cf. Gen 9:20.

verses.text_geez: ወዐቀቦ፡ እስከ፡ ዓመት፡ ኃምስ፡ ለዝንቱ፡ ሰቡዕ፡ ለዕለተ፡ በዓል፡ ወአፍረየ፡ ፍሬ፡ ምልዕተ፡ ለመሥዋዕት፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ቀዳማዊ፡ ዘሰብዐ፡ ላሕም፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ዘሐነጾ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʿaqabō ʾəska ʿāmat ḫāməs la-zəntu sabuʿ la-ʿəlata baʿāl wa-ʾafraya fəre mələʿta la-maśwāʿt qədma ʾəgziʾ lāʿla məśwāʿ qadāmāwi zasabʿa lāḥm lāʿla məśwāʿ zaḥanaḍo
verses.notes: **Noah waits 4 years before vintaging — observing the 'orlah' law (Lev 19:23-25: fruit of newly planted trees is forbidden for 3 years and consecrated in year 4).** **JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — Noah keeps orlah pre-Mosaic.** Cross-corpus: cf. Lev 19:23-25. The orlah-law is here etiologized as pre-Sinaitic-Noachic.

verses.text_geez: ወአዕረገ፡ ዐምድ፡ ዐርዘ፡ ጼዓዳ፡ በውስቴቱ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ወሥዋዐ፡ ሐዱደ፡ ዘላሕም፡ ወአዕረገ፡ ደሞ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ መጠረተ፡ ሥርቀተ፡ ዘፍሬሁ፡ ለመጠን፡ ዕጣን፡ ወቅዱስ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaʿraga ʿaməd ʿarza ṣēʿādā ba-wəstētu lāʿla məśwāʿ wa-śwāʿa ḥaddudē zalāḥm wa-ʾaʿraga damo lāʿla məśwāʿ lāʿla maṭarata śərqata zafərehu la-maṭan ʿəṭān wa-qəddusə
verses.notes: **Noah's elaborate sacrificial protocol — bullock + ram + sheep + goats with various incenses.** cf. Lev 1-7 sacrificial regulations etiologized as pre-Sinaitic.

verses.text_geez: ወአዕረገ፡ ኵሎ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ወወደየ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግብር፡ ጼዐደ፡ ወባሕተ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለመሐራቅ፡ ለፀዳይ፡ ዘመዓዛ፡ ሠናይ፡ ዘይትፈቀር፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaʿraga kwəlo maśwāʿta lāʿla məśwāʿ wa-wadaya lāʿla kwəlu gəbər ṣēʿada wa-bāḥta lottu la-maḥarāq la-ḍaday zamaʿāzā śannāy zayətfaqqar qədma ʾəgziʾ
verses.notes: **Pleasing aroma offered.** Continued cultic protocol.

verses.text_geez: ወአፍሰሰ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ዘወይን፡ ወዘዘይት፡ ላዕለ፡ ቍርባን፡ ወአዕረገ፡ ዕፃተ፡ ላዕለ፡ እሳት፡ ላዕሌሁ፡ ወቆርበቶ፡ ለዘይት፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾafsasa lāʿla məśwāʿ zawayən wa-zazaytə lāʿla qurbān wa-ʾaʿraga ʿəḍāta lāʿla ʾəsāt lāʿlēhu wa-qorbato la-zaytə lāʿla məśwāʿ
verses.notes: **Drink-offering of wine + oil libation.** Etiologized as Noachic. cf. Num 15:5-10 (drink-offerings).

verses.text_geez: ወእምድኅረዝ፡ ሰትዩ፡ ኢሙንቱ፡ በውእቱ፡ ደብር፡ ወአቀመ፡ ኖኅ፡ በዓላተ፡ ለዘርዑ፡ ለፍሥሐ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡ ለእግዚእ፡ በዓመት፡ ለ፫ ሰቡዕ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾəmdəḫrazə satyu ʾəmuntu ba-wəʾtu dabr wa-ʾaqama Noḫ baʿālāta la-zarʿu la-fəśḥā qədmēhomu la-ʾəgziʾ ba-ʿāmat la-3 sabuʿ
verses.notes: **Noah establishes festivals for his descendants — the inauguration-feast of the vineyard.**

verses.text_geez: ወሰትየ፡ ኖኅ፡ እምነ፡ ወይኑ፡ ወሰክረ፡ ወአዕረፈ፡ በማእከለ፡ ድንኳኑ፡ ወዕሩቅ፡ ይከውን፡
verses.translit: wa-satya Noḫ ʾəm-nə waynu wa-sakra wa-ʾaʿrafa ba-māʾkala dənkwānu wa-ʿəruq yəkawwən
verses.notes: **Noah drinks, becomes drunk, sleeps naked in his tent.** cf. Gen 9:21.

verses.text_geez: ወርእዮ፡ ሐም፡ ለኖኅ፡ አቡሁ፡ ዕሩቀ፡ ወወፅአ፡ ወዜነዎሙ፡ ለ፪ አኀዊሁ፡ ለአፍኣ፡
verses.translit: wa-rəʾəyo Ḥam la-Noḫ ʾabbuhu ʿəruqa wa-waḍʾa wa-zēnnawomu la-2 ʾəḫawihu la-ʾafʾā
verses.notes: **Ham sees Noah's nakedness and tells his brothers outside.** cf. Gen 9:22.

verses.text_geez: ወነሥአ፡ ሴም፡ ልብሰ፡ ወአንሥአ፡ ወቀመ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወያፌት፡ ወአልበስዎ፡ ለአቡሆሙ፡ እንዘ፡ ይትገሐሡ፡ ድኅረ፡ ወይከድኑ፡ ሐፍረቶ፡ ለአቡሆሙ፡ ወገጾሙ፡ ድኅረ፡
verses.translit: wa-naśʾa Sēm ləbsa wa-ʾansəʾa wa-qoma wəʾtu wa-Yāfet wa-ʾalbasəwo la-ʾabbuhomu ʾənza yətgaḥaśu dəḫra wa-yəkadnu ḥafrato la-ʾabbuhomu wa-gaṣṣomu dəḫra
verses.notes: **Shem + Japhet walk backward to cover Noah's nakedness.** cf. Gen 9:23.

verses.text_geez: ወአንቅሐ፡ ኖኅ፡ እምነ፡ ወይኑ፡ ወአእመረ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘገብሩ፡ ሎቱ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ወረገሞ፡ ለወልዱ፡ ወይቤ፡ ርጉም፡ ከንዓን፡ ገብረ፡ ገበር፡ ይኩን፡ ለአኀዊሁ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾanqəḥa Noḫ ʾəm-nə waynu wa-ʾaʾəmara kwəlu zagabru lottu daqiqu wa-ragagamo la-waldu wa-yəbē rəgum Kanʿān gabra gabar yəkun la-ʾəḫawihu
verses.notes: **THE CURSE OF CANAAN.** 'Cursed be Canaan; a slave of slaves shall he be to his brothers.' Direct citation of Gen 9:25. **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — the curse falls on CANAAN (the son of Ham), NOT directly on Ham.** This curse-of-Canaan etiology has been weaponized in deeply problematic ways in history; the Jubilees text preserves the basic Gen 9 transmission.

verses.text_geez: ወባረኮ፡ ለሴም፡ ወይቤ፡ ቡሩክ፡ እግዚእ፡ አምላከ፡ ሴም፡ ወይኩን፡ ከንዓን፡ ገብሮሙ፡ ወያሥፍሕ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለያፌት፡ ወይኅድር፡ ውስተ፡ ድንኳነ፡ ሴም፡ ወይኩን፡ ከንዓን፡ ገብሮሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-bārakō la-Sēm wa-yəbē buruk ʾəgziʾ ʾamlāka Sēm wa-yəkun Kanʿān gabromu wa-yāśfəḥ ʾəgziʾ la-Yāfet wa-yəḫdər wəsta dənkwāna Sēm wa-yəkun Kanʿān gabromu
verses.notes: **Noah's blessings: Shem blessed; Japhet to dwell in Shem's tents.** cf. Gen 9:26-27.

verses.text_geez: ወከንዐንሰ፡ ኢተአተወ፡ ምስሌሁ፡ አላ፡ ቦአ፡ ምድረ፡ ሊባኖስ፡ እምነ፡ ዮርዳኖስ፡ እስከ፡ ግብጽ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ አርያውያን፡ ወአልዘበ፡ ምድረ፡ በዓቅም፡
verses.translit: wa-Kanʿānsa ʾi-taʾatawa məslēhu ʾallā boʾa mədra Libānos ʾəm-nə Yordānos ʾəska Gəbṣ kwəlomu ʾaryāwəyān wa-ʾalzaba mədra ba-ʿaqəm
verses.notes: **Canaan refuses to return to his allotted territory and takes Lebanon-to-Egypt (the future Israelite-promised-land) instead.** **MAJOR JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — CANAAN'S TERRITORIAL TRESPASS IS THE ETIOLOGY OF THE LATER ISRAELITE CONQUEST.** Canaan was supposed to settle south of Africa; he stole Levant. This justifies the conquest of Canaan: it was retaking land Canaan stole. **Cross-corpus**: the territorial-allotment etiology is unique to Jubilees among ancient Jewish texts and provides a specific halakhic-political theology of the conquest.

verses.text_geez: ወይቤሎ፡ ሐም፡ አቡሁ፡ ወካም፡ ወያፌት፡ አኀዊሁ፡ አንተ፡ ሰሐትከ፡ በምድር፡ ዘአኮ፡ መክፈልትከ፡ ወአኮ፡ በተወልዶ፡ ለነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ሥርዐት፡ ላዕሌከ፡ ርጉም፡ አንተ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbēlo Ḥam ʾabbuhu wa-Kām wa-Yāfet ʾəḫawihu ʾanta saḥatka ba-mədr za-ʾakko makfaltka wa-ʾakko ba-tawaldo lana mawāʿəla śərʿat lāʿlēka rəgum ʾanta
verses.notes: **Family rebuke of Canaan.** Calendrically grounded — the territorial division is by formal divine assignment.

verses.text_geez: ወአንተ፡ ኢሰማዕከ፡ ቃለነ፡ ወአፅሐድከ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ወውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ዘአኮ፡ መክፈልትከ፡ ሰፈርከ፡ በእንተዝ፡ ርጉም፡ አንተ፡ ወትከውን፡ ርጉመ፡ ኵሎ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ሰብእ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾanta ʾi-samaʿka qālana wa-ʾaḍḥadka śərʿata wa-wəsta mədr za-ʾakko makfaltka safarka ba-ʾəntazə rəgum ʾanta wa-təkawwən rəguma kwəlu daqiqa sabʾ
verses.notes: **Continued rebuke of Canaan.**

verses.text_geez: ወአንቀጸ፡ ኖኅ፡ በውእቱ፡ ደብር፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ወአዘዞሙ፡ በብሕታዊት፡ ለልሕናጻዊ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾanqaḍa Noḫ ba-wəʾtu dabr śərʿata la-daqiqu wa-ʾazazomu ba-bəḥtāwit la-ləḥnāḍāwi
verses.notes: **Noah establishes ordinances on Mount Lubar.** Bridge to Noah's testament (vv. 20-39).

verses.text_geez: ወወለደ፡ ሎቱ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ወልደ፡ ራብዐ፡ ድኅረ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኪዳን፡ ወሰመዮ፡ ስሞ፡ ናፍ፡ እስመ፡ ይቤ፡ ናፍ፡ ፈረየ፡ ሊተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ድኅረ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡
verses.translit: wa-walada lottu la-Noḫ walda rābəʿa dəḫra zəntu kidān wa-samayō səmō Nāf ʾəsma yəbē Nāf faraya lita ʾəgziʾ dəḫra māya ʾāyəḫ
verses.notes: **A fourth son born to Noah after the Flood — named Naf.** **JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — A FOURTH NOAH-SON.** Genesis records only three (Shem/Ham/Japhet). This Naf-tradition is unique to Jubilees. cf. 1QapGen 12 (which preserves a similar tradition).

verses.text_geez: ወወለደ፡ ሴም፡ ለ፭ ደቂቅ፡ ኤላም፡ ወአሱር፡ ወአርፋክሰድ፡ ወአራም፡ ወሊዶ፡ ወወለደ፡ ሐም፡ ለ፬ ደቂቅ፡ ኩሽ፡ ወምስር፡ ወፉጥ፡ ወከንዓን፡ ወወለደ፡ ያፌት፡ ለ፯ ደቂቅ፡ ጎሜር፡ ወማጎጎ፡ ወማዳይ፡ ወያዋን፡ ወቱባል፡ ወሞሰሐ፡ ወቲራስ፡
verses.translit: wa-walada Sēm la-5 daqiq ʾElām wa-ʾAsur wa-ʾArfaksad wa-ʾArām wa-Liddo wa-walada Ḥam la-4 daqiq Kuš wa-Məsr wa-Fuṭ wa-Kanʿān wa-walada Yāfet la-7 daqiq Gomer wa-Magog wa-Māday wa-Yāwān wa-Tubāl wa-Mosaḥ wa-Tirās
verses.notes: **The grandchildren of Noah: 5 sons of Shem (Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Aram, Lud); 4 sons of Ham (Cush, Mizraim, Phut, Canaan); 7 sons of Japhet (Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, Tiras).** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — THE TABLE-OF-NATIONS GENEALOGY.** cf. Gen 10:1-32; cf. 1 Chr 1:5-23. Bridges to chs 8-9 land-division-by-lot. **The 5+4+7 = 16 grandsons match the Hellenistic geographical tripartition.**

verses.text_geez: ወበፍጻሜ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ዘ፴ ጸውዐ፡ ኖኅ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ውሉዶሙ፡ ወአኀዘ፡ ይዕዘዞሙ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘያአምር፡ ወአስምዐ፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀቡ፡ ጽድቀ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-fəṣṣāmē ʾiyobēləwu za-30 ṣawʿa Noḫ la-daqiqu wəludomu wa-ʾaḫaza yəʿzəzomu śərʿata kwəlo zayāʾammər wa-ʾasmaʿa lāʿla daqiqu kama yəʿqabu ṣədqa
verses.notes: **NOAH'S DEATHBED-TESTAMENT (vv 18-39).** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — TESTAMENT-LITERATURE PARALLEL**: cf. Test. 12 Patriarchs (Test. of Reuben, Levi, etc.); cf. 1 En 91-92 (Enoch's testament to children); cf. 1QapGen 19-22 (Noah's testament). Noah-testament becomes a foundational genre.

verses.text_geez: ወአስምዐ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ወአዘዞሙ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ጽድቀ፡ ወከመ፡ ይክድኑ፡ ሐፍረተ፡ ሥጋሆሙ፡ ወከመ፡ ይባርኩ፡ ለፈጣሪሆሙ፡ ወከመ፡ ያክብሩ፡ አበ፡ ወእመ፡ ወከመ፡ ያፍቅሩ፡ ቢጾሙ፡ ወከመ፡ ይዕቀቡ፡ ነፍሶሙ፡ እምነ፡ ዝሙት፡ ወእምነ፡ ርኵስ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዐመፃ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾasmaʿa lāʿlēhomu śərʿata wa-ʾazazomu kama yəgbaru ṣədqa wa-kama yəkdənu ḥafrata śəgāhomu wa-kama yəbāraku la-faṭārihomu wa-kama yākbəru ʾaba wa-ʾəmma wa-kama yāfqəru biṣomu wa-kama yəʿqabu nafsomu ʾəm-nə zəmut wa-ʾəm-nə rəkws wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu ʿamaḍā
verses.notes: **Noah's ethical commands: righteousness + nakedness-covering + blessing-Creator + honoring-parents + love-neighbor + avoiding fornication/impurity/iniquity.** **The 'Noahide Laws' in nascent form.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Acts 15:20, 29 (Noahide-pattern); cf. b. Sanhedrin 56a-b (the seven Noahide laws of rabbinic tradition).

verses.text_geez: እስመ፡ በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ሠለስቱ፡ መጽአ፡ አይኅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ እስመ፡ ዘመው፡ ወእስመ፡ አርኰሱ፡ ምድረ፡ ወእስመ፡ ግፍዕ፡ ኮነ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: ʾəsma ba-ʾənta zəntu śalastu maṣʾa ʾāyəḫ lāʿla mədr ʾəsma zammawu wa-ʾəsma ʾarkwasu mədra wa-ʾəsma gəfʿa kona lāʿla mədr
verses.notes: **The Flood came because of THREE SINS: fornication + uncleanness + violence.** **MAJOR — THE THREE PRE-FLOOD SINS** become the foundational Jubilees pre-Flood ethical paradigm. cf. Gen 6:11, 13.

verses.text_geez: እስመ፡ ዘመው፡ ትጉሃን፡ ምስለ፡ አንስት፡ ወአንስት፡ እምነ፡ ዘፈቀዱ፡ ይቤዙ፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ወአኀዙ፡ ይትሐናኰው፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ ወወለዱ፡ ሎሙ፡ ውሉደ፡ ወውእቶሙ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ኄሊያን፡
verses.translit: ʾəsma zammawu Təguhānə məsla ʾanəst wa-ʾanəst ʾəm-nə zafaqadu yəbēzu kiyāhomu wa-ʾaḫazu yətḥanāwwə məslēhomu wa-waladu lomu wəluda wa-wəʾətomu hallawu Ḥeliyān
verses.notes: **'Because the WATCHERS fornicated with the women, and they fornicated with whomever they desired, and they began to commingle with them, and they bore children for them — and these were the giants.'** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — RECAP OF THE WATCHERS NARRATIVE.** Bidirectional with v2.66.0 Watchers entry. **The Watchers fornication is foundational sin — picked up in 1 Cor 11:10 (women veil because of angels), 2 Pet 2:4, Jude 6.**

verses.text_geez: ወወለዱ፡ ኄሊያን፡ ለናፊል፡ ወአልጨቅ፡ ቆሙ፡ ኵሉ፡ እምነ፡ ካልኡ፡ በመጠን፡ ኂሩቶሙ፡ ወያቴሥቅሉ፡ አሐዱ፡ ካልኦ፡
verses.translit: wa-waladu Ḥeliyān la-Nāfil wa-ʾalṣaqq qomu kwəlu ʾəm-nə kāləʾu ba-maṭan ḥirutomu wa-yātēśqəlu ʾaḥadu kāləʾo
verses.notes: **THREE TYPES OF GIANTS: NAPHIDIM → NAPHIL → ELYO.** **MAJOR JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — THREE-GENERATION GIANT-HIERARCHY**: Naphidim → Nephilim → Elyo (each generation kills the prior — descending). The hierarchic war-of-giants picks up the giants war motif. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Gen 6:4 (Nephilim); cf. Num 13:33 (Anakim from Nephilim); cf. 1 En 7:2-5 (giants); cf. 4Q531 (Book of Giants); cf. 1QM 1 ('mighty ones'); cf. CD 2:18-21.

verses.text_geez: ወብዝኆሙ፡ ሰብእ፡ ዐመፃ፡ በምድር፡ ወአርኰሰ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ፍኖቶ፡ እምነ፡ ሰብእ፡ እስከ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወእስከ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእስከ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወእስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-bəzəḫomu sabʾ ʿamaḍā ba-mədr wa-ʾarkwasa kwəlu śəgā fənoto ʾəm-nə sabʾ ʾəska ʾənəssā wa-ʾəska ʾarāwit wa-ʾəska ʾaʿwāf wa-ʾəska kwəlu zayətḥawwas lāʿla mədr
verses.notes: **Universal corruption.** Recap of Jub 5:2.

verses.text_geez: ወአኀዙ፡ ይትበላዕ፡ አሐዱ፡ ለካልኡ፡ ወቦኡ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግፍዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወይክዕው፡ ደመ፡ ብዙኀ፡ ወይትገበር፡ ዕልወት፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾaḫazu yətballāʿ ʾaḥadu la-kāləʾu wa-boʾu kwəlu gəfʿa lāʿla mədr wa-yəkəʿwə dama bəzuḫa wa-yətgabbar ʿəlwat lāʿla mədr
verses.notes: **Cannibalism — devouring one another.** cf. 1 En 7:5.

verses.text_geez: ወአስተአተተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግዕዘ፡ ሥጋ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡ በእንተ፡ ዐመፃሆሙ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾastaʾtata ʾəgziʾ kwəlo gəʿza śəgā ʾəm-nə mədr ba-ʾənta ʿamaḍāhomu lāʿla mədr
verses.notes: **God blots out all flesh because of their iniquity.**

verses.text_geez: ወአንሰ፡ ናሁ፡ ናስተአተት፡ ካዕበ፡ መውት፡ ለደቂቅነ፡ እኅዜ፡ አንሰ፡ ናሁ፡ እሬእይ፡ መውዓ፡ ለሰብእ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾansa nāhu nāstaʾtat kāʿba mawt la-daqiqəna ʾəḥzē ʾansa nāhu ʾərēʾəy mawʿā la-sabʾ
verses.notes: **Noah laments the future of his children — fearing they will sin and be destroyed.**

verses.text_geez: ወአንሰ፡ ሰማዕኩ፡ ናሁ፡ ሰይጣናተ፡ አኀዙ፡ ያስሕትዎሙ፡ ለደቂቅክሙ፡ ወይትገበር፡ ኪያሆሙ፡ ኩናኔ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾansa samāʿku nāhu sayṭānāta ʾaḫazu yāsḥətəwomu la-daqiqəkəmu wa-yətgabbar kiyāhomu kwənnānē
verses.notes: **'I have heard that DEMONS [sayṭānāt] have begun to lead astray your children, and judgment will be done to them.'** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — FORESHADOWING THE MASTEMA + GIANTS-AS-EVIL-SPIRITS NARRATIVE OF JUB 10.** **Bidirectional with v2.66.0 glossary entry `giants-become-evil-spirits-demonology-1-enoch-15-cross-corpus-jub-10-tertullian`.** Noah here foresees the evil-spirits problem to be addressed in ch 10:1-14.

verses.text_geez: ወሰብእ፡ ዘይዜምው፡ ምስለ፡ ሰብእ፡ ይትጋዱል፡ በምድር፡ ወዘይክዐው፡ ደመ፡ በምድር፡ ይትገበር፡ ፍትሕ፡
verses.translit: wa-sabʾ zayəzēmmuwə məsla sabʾ yətgāddul ba-mədr wa-zayəkəʿaw dama ba-mədr yətgabbar fətḥ
verses.notes: **Continued warning against fornication + blood-shedding.**

verses.text_geez: ወወልድ፡ ዘይዜምው፡ ምስለ፡ እኅቱ፡ ወብእሲት፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘአልቦ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ዘይትዐዘዝ፡ ቅቱላን፡ ይኩኑ፡
verses.translit: wa-wald zayəzēmmuwə məsla ʾəḫətu wa-bəʾəsit məsla bəʾəsi za-ʾalbo la-sabʾ zayətʿazzəzə qətulān yəkunu
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 7:29; VanderKam 1989) — note: this verse condemns incest specifically, complicating the pre-flood sister-marriages of Jub 3:33 + 4:9-10 etc.; VanderKam Hermeneia notes the apparent contradiction
verses.notes: **Capital sentence for incest.** **EDITORIAL NOTE — APPARENT CONTRADICTION**: Jubilees explicitly narrates sister-marriages of Cain, Seth, Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech (Jub 3:33; 4:9, 11, 16, 27, 28, 33) — yet here Noah declares incest a capital offense. **The Jubilees solution: pre-flood necessity-marriages within bloodline are permitted; POST-flood incest is forbidden.** The Noahide-pattern marks a halakhic transition.

verses.text_geez: ወዐቀባ፡ ለነፍሰክሙ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግፍዕ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዐመፃ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዓመፃ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይነጥቅ፡ መሐለ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʿaqabā la-nafsakəmu ʾəm-nə kwəlu gəfʿ wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu ʿamaḍā wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu ḫāṭiʾat wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu ʿāmaḍā wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu zayənaṭṭəq maḥala
verses.notes: **Keep yourselves from violence, iniquity, sin, oath-breaking.**

verses.text_geez: ወሥርዐት፡ ዘመሐለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ለደቂቁ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ዘመጻኦ፡ ለሎቱ፡ በዕለታት፡ ዘይትዘከር፡ ለመዋዕለ፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡
verses.translit: wa-śərʿat zamaḥala Noḫ la-daqiqu ṣəḥuf zamaṣaʾo la-lottu ba-ʿəlatāt zayətzakkar la-mawāʿəl la-təwlədomu la-ʿālam
verses.notes: **Noah's oath inscribed for perpetual memory.** Noah-Sefer-Berit established.

verses.text_geez: ወባሕቱ፡ አንትሙ፡ ደቂቅየ፡ ዐቀባ፡ ለነፍሰክሙ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ግፍዕ፡ ዘገብሩ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አባዊክሙ፡
verses.translit: wa-bāḥtu ʾantəmu daqiqəya ʿaqabā la-nafsakəmu ʾəm-nə kwəlu śərʿata gəfʿ zagabru mawāʿəla ʾabāwikəmu
verses.notes: **Noah commands his sons to keep themselves from the iniquity of pre-Flood ancestors.**

verses.text_geez: እስመ፡ ምድር፡ ትሬኢ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብር፡ ዘይትገበር፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ወትትዜከር፡ ኵሎ፡ በዕለታት፡ ኩናኔ፡
verses.translit: ʾəsma mədr tərēʾi kwəlo gəbər zayətgabbar lāʿlēhā wa-tətzēkar kwəlo ba-ʿəlatāt kwənnānē
verses.notes: **The earth sees all deeds and remembers on judgment day.** Earth-as-cosmic-witness motif. cf. Gen 4:10.

verses.text_geez: ወይኬብርን፡ ምድር፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግፍዕ፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ወእምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ግዕዝ፡ ዘይትገበር፡ ላዕሌሃ፡
verses.translit: wa-yəkēbbərən mədr ʾəm-nə kwəlu gəfʿ wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu ḫāṭiʾat wa-ʾəm-nə kwəlu gəʿz zayətgabbar lāʿlēhā
verses.notes: **Earth-defilement etiology.**

verses.text_geez: ወበራብዕ፡ ዓመት፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ይኩን፡ ቅዱስ፡ ፍሬሁ፡ ቡሩከ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-rābəʿ ʿāmat la-la-ʿāmat yəkun qəddusə fərehu buruka qədma ʾəgziʾ
verses.notes: **Fourth-year fruit consecrated.** Orlah law (Lev 19:23-24).

verses.text_geez: ወበኃምስ፡ ዓመት፡ ይትበላዕ፡ ፍሬሁ፡ ለርእስከ፡ ሐራ፡ ቡሩከ፡ ኀበ፡ እግዚእ፡
verses.translit: wa-ba-ḫāməs ʿāmat yətballāʿ fərehu la-rəʾəsəka ḥarā buruka ḫaba ʾəgziʾ
verses.notes: **Fifth-year fruit eaten by owner.** Continued orlah law.

verses.text_geez: በከመ፡ አዘዘ፡ አብርሃም፡ አባሁ፡ ለይስሐቅ፡ ወይስሐቅ፡ ለያዕቆብ፡ ወያዕቆብ፡ ለ፫ ደቂቁ፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኖኅ፡ እስከ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አብርሃም፡
verses.translit: ba-kama ʾazaza ʾAbrəhām ʾabbāhu la-Yəsḥaq wa-Yəsḥaq la-Yāʿqob wa-Yāʿqob la-3 daqiqu ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla Noḫ ʾəska mawāʿəla ʾAbrəhām
verses.notes: **Patrilineal-transmission chain of orlah law from Noah through patriarchs.**

verses.text_geez: በከመ፡ መሐራ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ለማቱሳላ፡ ወልዱ፡ ወማቱሳላ፡ ለላሜክ፡ ወልዱ፡ ወላሜክ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ወልዱ፡ ኵሎ፡ ዘመሐርዎ፡ አበዊሁ፡
verses.translit: ba-kama maḥarā Henok la-Mātusālā waldu wa-Mātusālā la-Lāmek waldu wa-Lāmek la-Noḫ waldu kwəlo zamaḥarəwo ʾabawihu
verses.notes: **Pre-Flood transmission chain: ENOCH → METHUSELAH → LAMECH → NOAH.** **MAJOR — ENOCHIC PRE-FLOOD TORAH-TRANSMISSION.** Noah's halakhic wisdom comes through the Enochic line. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 1 En 81:5-6 (Enoch transmits to Methuselah); cf. 1 En 82:1-3 (Enoch's books to Methuselah).

verses.text_geez: ወአንሰ፡ ኒሁ፡ ኦደቂቅየ፡ እኤዝዘክሙ፡ በከመ፡ አዘዘኒ፡ ሄኖክ፡ በቀዳማዊ፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ ዘሕያው፡ ሎቱ፡ ምስለ፡ መላእክተ፡ እግዚእ፡ ይነግረኒ፡ ኵሎ፡
verses.translit: wa-ʾansa naḫu ʾo daqiqəya ʾəʾēzəzəkəmu ba-kama ʾazazani Henok ba-qadāmāwi ʾiyobēləwu zaḥəyāw lottu məsla malāʾəkta ʾəgziʾ yənaggərani kwəlo
verses.notes: **'I, Noah, command you my children as ENOCH COMMANDED ME — Enoch is alive in the first jubilee with the angels of the Lord, and he tells me everything.'** **MAJOR — ENOCH AS LIVING ORACLE.** Noah claims direct teaching from the still-living Enoch. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. Jub 4:23 (Enoch translated to Eden). Closes the chapter.
